findings.source_quote:
What joy the happy earth to greet
In new, bright raiment clad!
findings.suggested_fix:
Render the sense closer to the English image of joy at greeting the earth clothed in new bright raiment. For example: "يا لها من بهجةٍ في استقبالِ الأرضِ البهيَّةِِ لِلْبَسِها رِداءً جديدًا مُشرقًا!"—preserving stanza tags and line breaks inside the

element.
